opening.argument: The description offers 2,000 PKR per referral, promises “Unlimited” earning, and expressly seeks 20 networkers or interested members. The stated benefit is therefore tied to recruiting a multi-person network rather than to an independently described transaction. By inviting interested people to make contact, the message directs viewers toward participation through the listed referral pathway, presenting network growth as the route to earning. Those features establish a recruitment-based commission structure with an unlimited-earning appeal.
